messages.subject: Re: Mac installation warning/error
parts:
As the warnings indicate, that repository does not seem to exist? It seems to be missing 2.15 from that server.

Try another repository such as http://cran.r-project.org/bin/macosx/leopard/contrib/2.15/

Or you could try installing source as per the message - though that may need more work.

Graham Williams
http://togaware.com


On 20 February 2013 01:02, Michael Shanahan <mjsha...@gmail.com> wrote:
Hi,

any help with this would be greatly appreciated! on Mac OSx 10.7.5:


The downloaded source packages are in
    ‘/private/var/folders/2y/wrbkyrfs5s3fly0_1q0fml5r0000gn/T/Rtmpgom07V/downloaded_packages’
> library(rattle)
> rattle()
The package 'RGtk2' is required to display the Rattle GUI. It does not appear to be installed. This package
(and its dependencies) can be installed using the following R command:

install.packages('RGtk2')

Would you like Rattle to install the package now?
